subject: words
title: Gruffalo Words
objective: Learn descriptive words: terrible, tusks, claws, brave, clever.

story_beats.text: Tara shivers playfully. 'The Gruffalo has TERRIBLE tusks and TERRIBLE claws! Terrible means very, very scary!'
But the little mouse was CLEVER — he tricked the Gruffalo with his smart ideas!

interactions.prompt: The mouse tricked the Gruffalo. The mouse was...

hint_sequence: Look at each choice, one by one.
Tara points at the two closest choices.
transfer_question: Use the word 'brave' in a sentence about yourself.

feedback.correct: Wonderful words! Your vocabulary is growing like the deep dark wood!
feedback.retry: Listen to the story again — terrible means VERY scary!

off_screen: Make your own terrible face in the mirror. Roar!
parent_note: Vocabulary: terrible, tusks, claws, brave, clever. Descriptive language.
